name: NURS 4282
title: Nursing Leadership and Capstone Practicum
description: In-depth analysis of the components that facilitate new nursing graduates to become leaders in healthcare, within diverse interprofessional groups, and in the community. Students will have an opportunity to explore professional nursing issues as they synthesize knowledge, skills, and values from all prior learning to provide safe care as a beginning practitioner. An interprofessional approach to resolving problems, enhancing leadership through decision-making, and collaborating with culturally diverse teams are used.
requirement_description: NURS 3334, NURS 3444, NURS 3554, NURS 3664, and NURS 4230W.
